name: Missing In Action
label: Quest
description: In the Redridge Mountains, Corporal Keeshan is missing after his regiment was overrun. Blackrock orcs knocked him unconscious and dragged him into a cave…

clips.title: The story
paras: In the Redridge Mountains, Corporal Keeshan is missing after his regiment was overrun. Blackrock orcs knocked him unconscious and dragged him into a cave fortress. Now he needs an escort back to Lakeshire, where the garrison can learn what became of the missing men.

Blackrock orcs descend from the northern peaks, making the Redridge Mountains more perilous. Town guard patrols often meet ambushes, and Corporal Keeshan's unit suffered the worst of them. The regiment was outnumbered and overwhelmed, and most of its soldiers fell in the attack. Keeshan survived when a crushing blow knocked him unconscious before the orcs could execute him. They dragged him to their cave as a prisoner.

Battered and concussed, Keeshan is held deep in enemy territory and cannot make the trek down the mountain alone. You escort him toward Lakeshire, past the orc warbands occupying the ridgelines. Marshal Marris has been trying to learn what happened to the missing regiment while preparing Lakeshire for further attacks. Keeshan's safe return brings him sorely needed relief.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: At last, friends of the Alliance!

The last thing I remember these foul Orcs overpowered our regiment. Most the men were killed. I took a strong blow to the head and everything went black. Now I am held captive in this cave. Help me, I am hurt badly.
I'll need help getting back to town... Please... You're my last hope...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have served the Kingdom well, adventurer. Thank you for assisting Corporal Keeshan with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs. You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
